Elevated three-quarter overhead view, no horizon, refined painterly miniature board-game aesthetic, broad readable shapes at small hex size. One continuous landscape fills the square edge to edge, central grey rock faces and stone blocks, simpler rocky mossy ground at the lower edge. No people, text, numbers, frame, hex outline, watermark or grid.
